cues.en: So we just add an A and now we are starting with the arc cosine or the inverse cosine function instead of the regular or the forward cosine function.

cues.en: And then let's see what happens.

cues.en: So we get something that looks really complicated because really hairy towards the end.

cues.zh: 也注意，從最一開始，三角函數就完全消失了。

cues.en: So the derivative of the arc cosine or the inverse cosine function is itself one over the square root of one minus x squared.
cues.zh: 反餘弦函數的導數，本身是 1 除以 1 減 x 平方的平方根。

cues.en: So this is actually not a simple inverse trig function rule, so it doesn't follow the same patterns.
cues.zh: 所以這其實不是簡單的反三角函數法則，不遵循相同模式。
